news.title: Mexicans view President Claudia Sheinbaum favorably, but less so than in 2025
news.summary_en: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum remains popular, but her favorability has dropped to 64%. Views of the economy and democracy are also declining.

news.title: How we measured Americans’ engagement in public life
news.summary_en: This piece explains how researchers measured Americans’ engagement in public life using multimode surveys, address-based sampling and cluster analysis.

news.title: How Americans Are Engaged With News, Politics, Religion and Civic Life
news.summary_en: Americans’ engagement with others is not one-dimensional. Instead, they sort into four distinct groups that reflect different patterns of participation in society.

news.title: People in Many Countries Now View China More Positively Than the U.S.
news.summary_en: Views of China have improved recently while views of the U.S. have worsened, to the point where China is now seen more positively than the U.S. in most countries surveyed.

news.title: Views of China and Xi Are Improving Globally
news.summary_en: Growing shares of people see China favorably and have confidence in Xi Jinping, though opinions are much less positive in wealthier nations.

news.title: Party Affiliation Fact Sheet (NPORS)
news.summary_en: Explore trends in partisan identification among U.S. adults using data from Pew Research Center’s National Public Opinion Reference Survey (NPORS).

news.title: National Public Opinion Reference Survey (NPORS)
news.summary_en: NPORS is an annual survey of U.S. adults conducted by the Pew Research Center used to to produce benchmark estimates for several topics.

news.title: Nearly 6 in 10 young women get health and wellness information from influencers
news.summary_en: Young women are especially likely to say they often see influencer content about beauty and appearance.
